Traceable: R2.Q2 free-text ('목록만 딱 보이면 되고, 따로 알림 안 와도 괜찮아요') + R3.Q1 (manual execution) + R1.Q1 (daily 07:00 CSV source). Neither real-time monitoring nor per-product push survives.

expectations.text: Integration honored: the data source is the daily POS CSV email attachment (the requester's only access path) — no invented API/DB integration, traceable to a question about where inventory data lives

Constraints pin '입력 소스는 샵플 POS CSV 하나 (다른 재고 소스 없음)' and '메일 계정 연동/권한 불필요 — 사용자가 CSV를 직접 건네는 수동 실행'. No invented API/DB — 메일함 자동 감지 was offered but deferred/excluded, leaving the CSV email as the only path.

expectations.text: Threshold trap resolved: reorder criterion is the per-product 안전재고 column already in the CSV — a global fixed threshold (e.g. 'under 10') is not silently adopted; the user's Other correction or an asked question lands it
expectations.evidence: R1.Q3 offered 품목별 최소 수량 (Recommended) / 전 품목 공통 수량 / 판매 속도 / 안 정함. User selected 품목별 최소 수량 with free-text '상품마다 달라요. CSV에 이미 안전재고 칸이 있어요.' The global '전 품목 공통 수량' option was NOT adopted. Final Decision: '품목별 — 현재수량 < 안전재고 (CSV에 안전재고 칸 존재)'. Threshold correctly per-product.

expectations.text: With no codebase to inspect (greenfield), questions ground in the user's actual situation and vocabulary (solo shop owner, no developer, spreadsheet-level skills) and never re-ask facts derivable from the request itself
expectations.evidence: run_log confirms empty greenfield dir, no territory sweep, questions grounded in the request's domain. After R1.Q1 surfaced 샵플 POS CSV, subsequent rounds speak that vocabulary (CSV 수급, 안전재고, 07:00 메일). Respects the non-technical persona — steers toward the simple manual Recommended option over IMAP/OAuth auto-detect. No re-asking of request-derivable facts; platform-brand list appears only as source hypotheses, not as re-asks.

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 led with 재고 데이터 위치 — the source/integration axis that decides deliverable form (direct connect vs file hand-off) — and harvested the 샵플 07:00 CSV reframe on the first payload; 기준/후속/채널 followed. No administrative questions in any round.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Docked 2→1. A genuine interviewer-raised UU (silent-data-gap warning, R2.Q3 — not even in the brief) did land in the spec as Success Criteria/Assumption, which clears the letter of the rubric. But the run missed the brief's designated PRIMARY UU — the already-ordered exclusion (재입고 대기 상품이 매일 재출현) — which is never probed in any of the 8 questions and is absent from the final spec, directly undercutting the '아침 10분 발주 결정' success criterion. Catching a secondary blind-spot while missing the material one keeps this off a clean 2.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield-aware (empty dir, no invented code); leads with the source/integration point instead of re-asking derivable facts; questions speak the user's real vocabulary (샵플 CSV/안전재고/07:00 메일) and respect the spreadsheet-level, no-developer persona by defaulting to manual execution.

D4_economy.evidence: 8 questions, no filler — every answer changed the spec. multiSelect used for the genuinely non-exclusive R1.Q2 channel; dependent axes correctly deferred (CSV 수급/실행 모델 depend on source → R2/R3) rather than jammed into R1; recommended defaults offered on every deferrable. R2.Q2's channel re-ask was a legitimate re-confirmation of the R1.Q2 defer, not padding.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Exemplary Decisions/Assumptions/Surfaced/Still Open partition with a full 8-row claim-audit ledger; deferred and option-description-sourced values are honestly filed as Assumptions (no disguise, no laundering), and the unsourced CSV encoding detail is flagged Still Open rather than asserted. No fabrication. Honesty of the synthesis is complete for what was covered (the coverage gap is a D2 matter, not a D5 one).

eval_feedback: Strong with_skill run on a gen-2 holdout that nails three of the four traps and stays fabrication-clean, but misses the brief's designated primary unknown-unknown. WINS: cadence trap resolved to a run-and-see manual tool with real-time monitoring AND per-product push both in Scope 제외 (R2.Q2 free-text + R3.Q1); integration honored to the sole 샵플 07:00 CSV email path with no invented API (R1.Q1 led with the source axis); threshold correctly per-product 안전재고 from CSV, global fixed threshold offered-but-not-adopted (R1.Q3); and — the model behavior of note — every option-description-sourced value (수동 실행/지정 폴더, 데이터-미수신→빈/깨진 CSV 경고 reinterpretation) is filed under Assumptions with an 8-row claim audit, avoiding the run-6-style source laundering. Clean COMPLETE at cap with spare budget. MISS: the already-ordered exclusion (재입고 대기 상품이 매일 재출현 + 발주 기록 병행 입력) is never interviewer-raised and never lands in the spec — the interview instead spent its blind-spot slot on the data-missing warning (a real but secondary UU). That single miss carries the already-ordered assertion FAIL and docks D2 2→1. 15/16, rubric 9/10 — calibration-parallel to the run-6 anchor (one both-arm trap FAIL + one docked dimension).
